title: nitrateApp
text: Rising river nitrate concentrations becoming increasingly threatening aquatic ecosystems. nitrateApp package provides clean dataset interactive app explore visualise nitrate concentrations three NEON sites June - July 2019. vignette demonstrates : Load inspect dataset Use simple functions explore data Run interactive Shiny app

title: nitrateApp
text: nitrates_small dataset small version nitrate concentration datasets available NEON. sites differ nitrate concentrations due individual geographic aquatic characteristics. differences patterns can explored using nitrates_small dataset.
code: library(nitrateApp) data("nitrates_small", package = "nitrateApp") str(nitrates_small) #> Classes 'tbl_df', 'tbl' and 'data.frame':    183 obs. of  3 variables: #>  $ site       : chr  "ARIK" "ARIK" "ARIK" "ARIK" ... #>  $ date       : Date, format: "2019-06-01" "2019-06-02" ... #>  $ nitrate_mgL: num  5.3 5.2 5.15 5.32 5.13 ...

what: Helper examples to explore the dataset
title: nitrateApp
code: library(dplyr)  nitrates_small |>   group_by(site)|>   summarise(     mean_mgL = mean(nitrate_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),     min_mgL = min(nitrate_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),     max_mgL = max(nitrate_mgL, na.rm = TRUE)   ) #> # A tibble: 3 × 4 #>   site  mean_mgL min_mgL max_mgL #>   <chr>    <dbl>   <dbl>   <dbl> #> 1 ARIK      4.39    1.05    8.88 #> 2 CARI     23.9    20.5    29.3  #> 3 LEWI    197.    132.    211.

title: nitrateApp
code: library(ggplot2)  ggplot(nitrates_small, aes(date, nitrate_mgL, color = site)) + geom_line() + geom_point() + labs(x = NULL, y = "Nitrate (mg/L)", title = "Daily nitrate concentrations by site") + theme_minimal()
